name: votepulse-online-voting-system
description: Secure, Authenticated Online Voting & Election Management System PWA built with Node.js, Express, SQLite, and Real-Time OTP Verification.

scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('dist', 'docs', {recursive: true}); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'docs/404.html'); fs.writeFileSync('docs/.nojekyll', ''); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', '404.html'); fs.cpSync('dist/assets', 'assets', {recursive: true}); fs.writeFileSync('.nojekyll', ''); ['docs/index.html','docs/404.html','dist/index.html','index.html','404.html'].forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync(f)){fs.writeFileSync(f,fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').replace(/<link rel=\"manifest\" href=\".\/.+?\.json\">/,'<link rel=\"manifest\" href=\"./manifest.json\">'))}}); console.log('✅ Build synced + manifest link fixed!');"
